## Motivation & Modifications

Summary:
- MI355X High-Throughput cell for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash:
  - `HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0`: back the HiCache host pools with `hipHostMalloc`. With registered pageable memory the first HiCache write hits a HIP illegal memory access on MI355X.
  - `--hicache-size 180 --hicache-write-policy write_back` instead of the default ratio (~350 GB per rank), so two TP4 servers fit on one host.
  - Default bf16 DSpark draft KV (drop `--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`), as measured.
  - Mark the cell verified; replace the "not measured on MI355X" note.
- Image unchanged (`lmsysorg/sglang:dev-minimax-m31-flash-mi35x`).

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K at 64 concurrent sessions with HiCache: 96.59 strict / 96.51 flexible.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

AgentX on MI355X, TP4 + HiCache: 90,168 tok/s per GPU at concurrency 64, P90 TTFT 1.21 s. Concurrency 48 also passed.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

detail.title: [Doc] [AMD] cookbook: Verify MiniMax-M3.1-Flash High-Throughput on MI355X

files.patch:
@@ -146,7 +146,7 @@ The B300 **Low-Latency** recipe serves batch-size-1 decode through the MSA-V1 Mo
   - **Hierarchical KV cache** (`--enable-hierarchical-cache`). At the default ratio of 2, the host pools (main KV, index K and draft KV) take about 350 GB per rank, so one TP4 server needs about 1.4 TB of host memory. On a host with less free memory, the server lowers the ratio until the pools fit in 80% of it. When two servers share a host, lower `--hicache-host-memory-fraction` on each.
   - **FP8 DSpark draft KV cache** (`--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3`). The same memory holds 9% more tokens. The draft cache only affects which draft tokens get accepted; the target model still verifies every token.
 - **`--prefill-decode-interval 16`** runs 16 decode steps after each prefill batch before the next prefill. With 64 concurrent sessions and HiCache on MI350X, it lowered P90 inter-token latency by about 10% at the cost of about 3% throughput.
-- The High-Throughput recipe was measured on MI350X. MI355X runs the same command but has not been measured with it.
+- **High-Throughput on MI355X** sets `--hicache-size 180 --hicache-write-policy write_back` and `HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0`, and keeps the default bf16 draft KV cache. The environment variable backs the HiCache host pools with `hipHostMalloc`; without it the first HiCache write fails with a HIP illegal memory access. 180 GB per rank lets two TP4 servers share one host. With 64 concurrent sessions it reached 90,168 tokens/s per GPU with a P90 TTFT of 1.21 s.
 
 ## 3. Advanced Usage

@@ -801,10 +801,13 @@ const cfg = {
         "--port {{PORT}}",
       ],
     },
+    // AgentX at 48 and 64 sessions on MI355X: GSM8K 96.59 at 64. Registered pageable host
+    // pools fault at the first HiCache write, so HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0 allocates them
+    // with hipHostMalloc (#42553); 180 GB per rank fits two servers per host.
     {
       match: { hw: "mi355x", variant: "flash", quant: "nvfp4", strategy: "high-throughput", nodes: "single" },
-      warn: AMD_HICACHE_NOTE,
-      env: ["SGLANG_USE_AITER=1"],
+      verified: true,
+      env: ["SGLANG_USE_AITER=1", "HSA_USERPTR_FOR_PAGED_MEM=0"],
       flags: [
         "--trust-remote-code",
         "--model-path {{MODEL_NAME}}",
@@ -813,7 +816,6 @@ const cfg = {
         "--tp 4",
         "--speculative-algorithm DSPARK",
         "--speculative-use-block-verification",
-        "--speculative-draft-kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3",
         "--cuda-graph-backend-prefill breakable",
         "--fp8-gemm-backend aiter",
         "--chunked-prefill-size 32768",
@@ -822,6 +824,8 @@ const cfg = {
         "--mem-fraction-static 0.8",
         "--tokenizer-worker-num 8",
         "--enable-hierarchical-cache",
+        "--hicache-size 180",
+        "--hicache-write-policy write_back",
         "--host {{HOST_IP}}",
         "--port {{PORT}}",
       ],
